Assam Chief Minister Supports Tougher Anti-Drug Measures

Himanta Sarma has rejected suggestions that drug abuse is confined to any particular community or region. He has promised stricter action against drugs in Assam, but his comments have also been seen as an attempt to unite the Hindu community. The CAA has played a role in shaping his approach to politics.
